{{Quote|Canopy! Oh, this is worse then I thought. There is a group of bandits that work in that area who call themselves the Canopy bandits. They have a reputation for being absolutely vicious.|[[Lisum]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMR" />}}
The '''Canopy Bandits''' were a group of criminals present on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
{{Quote|I need you to find the Canopy bandit's camp and see if you can find my friends there. They are probably just being held captive for ransom. You know...that is what bandits do.|Lisum, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMR" />}}
[[File:Canopy_bandit_camp.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The [[Canopy bandit's camp]].]]
The Canopy Bandits were present on the planet Kashyyyk and were mainly active in the region of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]]. They had a [[Canopy bandit's camp|camp]] located on a cliff overlooking a river next to the [[Bolotaur Beach]].<ref name="SWG:TMR" />

The bandits were known to be particularly vicious. One of their more lucrative activities was to kidnap for ransom inocent people venturing in the wilderness of Kashyyyk. The criminals consisted mostly of off-worlders but also included native [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]. They used to wear dark green clothes, likely to hide in the forested environment of Kashyyyk.<ref name="SWG:TMR" />

==History==
{{Quote|So...they are dead...oh Jillian, I told you not to go. ...I know it is a lot to ask but could you perhaps do one more thing for me? I want you to make those Canopy bandits pay. Pay for what they have done to my friends...to Jillian.|Lisum, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TMR" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Canopy bandits attacked a [[Research Camp|research camp]] used by a group of scientits came to Kashyyyk to study local flora. The criminals captured the researchers and brought them captive to their camp. However, for some reason, they executed all the scientists, including [[Jillian]], [[Bathoz]] and [[Rengar]], instead of asking for a ransom.<ref name="SWG:TMR" />

[[File:Kashyyyk_dead_researchers.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The corpses of the dead researchers.]]

A short time later, a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] discovered the destroyed research camp. While investigating the camp site, a spacer was contacted over the radio by another researcher, [[Lisum]], who was trying to liaise with his friends. The spacer accepted to help to uncover the researchers' fate and the adventurers therefore searched the camp for clues. When one of the spacers found the word "Canopy" written on a dented drum, Lisum immediately understood that the scientists had been taken by the Canopy bandits. He thus requested the spacers to find the Canopy bandit's camp where his colleages where likely held captive. The adventurers explored the area and finally found the bandit's lair. However, it was already too late and they only found the corpses of the dead scientists in the camp. Enraged, Lisum asked them to make the criminals pay for what they did. The spacers eventually killed fifteen Canopy bandits out of vengeance.<ref name="SWG:TMR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Canopy Bandits appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RotW" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Canopy Bandits were added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']] on [[May 5]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:RotW" />
